name: Chain of Conviction
summary: Bonus Action, 30 ft, Str save: 2d6 Force (half on a success); on a failure the target is pulled up to 30 ft, chained (can't get more than 30 ft from you) and you have Advantage against it.
text: You hurl a spectral, barbed chain at a creature you can see within 30 feet. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure it takes 2d6 Force damage, is pulled up to 30 feet toward you, and is bound by the chain. While bound it is tethered to you: it cannot move or teleport to a space more than 30 feet from you, and you have Advantage on attack rolls against it. On a success it takes half as much damage and nothing else. The bound target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the spell on itself on a success. If you are ever more than 30 feet from the target, the spell ends. Duration 1 minute (no Concentration). Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 2.
